core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hamzah corresponds to the Arabic form حمزة (Arabic root ح م ز (ḥ-m-z); حَمْزَة (Ḥamza)). Its core sense is lion; brave, courageous. Hamzah is a transliteration of Arabic حَمْزَة (Ḥamza), the name of the Prophet's uncle. The source gloss 'prolonged stop' describes the unrelated grammatical term هَمْزَة (hamza, the glottal-stop mark) and has been replaced with the sense of the personal name. Same name as hamza.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Hamzah, hamzah. Script forms are حمزة, حمزه, حمزہ, हमज़ा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
